cases.translation: My heart exults in the Lord.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) governing location takes the prepositional case.

cases.translation: There is no one as holy as the Lord.
cases.explain: The Lord is the subject of this comparison, requiring nominative case.

cases.translation: The bows of the warriors are broken.
cases.explain: Possession is marked by the genitive case in Russian.

cases.sentence: Дай мне какую-нибудь священническую должность, чтобы у меня было ___.
cases.translation: Give me some priestly office that I may have livelihood.
cases.explain: Пропитание is the subject complement of было, requiring nominative case.

cases.sentence: В кастрюлю, сковороду, котел или горшок опускал вилку ___.
cases.translation: The servant would dip the fork into the pot.
cases.explain: Слуга is the subject of the verb опускал, requiring nominative case.

cases.sentence: Елкана пошел к себе домой, а мальчик остался служить перед ___.
cases.translation: Elkanah went to his home, but the child remained to serve before the Lord.
cases.explain: The preposition перед (before) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Каждый год мать шила для него маленький плащ и приносила ему, когда приходила с ___.
cases.translation: Every year his mother made him a little robe and brought it to him when she came with her husband.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) governs the instrumental case.

cases.translation: The word of the Lord came to the prophet.
cases.explain: Direction of motion is marked by the dative case (к + dative).

reading.ru: Молитва Анны Анна молилась и говорила.
reading.question: What was Hannah doing in the opening of this chapter?
reading.explain: Анна молилась и говорила - Hannah was praying and speaking.

reading.ru: Возликовало мое сердце в Господе, вознесся в Господе мой урок, мои уста осмеивают врагов, потому что я радуюсь твоему избавлению.
reading.question: What does Hannah say her heart exults in?
reading.explain: Hannah states that she exults in God's salvation (твоему избавлению).

reading.ru: Нет столь святого, как Господь, нет другого, кроме тебя, нет скалы, подобной нашему Богу.
reading.question: What does Hannah declare about the Lord's holiness?
options: He is alone in his holiness
He is more holy than angels
reading.correct: He is alone in his holiness
reading.explain: Hannah says 'There is no one as holy as the Lord; there is no one besides you.'

reading.question: What was Samuel doing while Eli's sons were acting wickedly?
reading.explain: The text explicitly states 'But Samuel ministered before the Lord.'

reading.ru: Каждый год мать шила для него маленький плащ и приносила ему, когда приходила с мужем.
reading.question: What did Samuel's mother do for him every year?
options: Made him a little robe and brought it
reading.correct: Made him a little robe and brought it
reading.explain: His mother made a little robe and brought it to him when she came with her husband.

reading.ru: Господь был милостив к Анне, и она зачила и родила еще троих сыновей и двух дочерей.
reading.question: How many more children did Hannah bear after Samuel?
reading.explain: She bore трех сыновей (three sons) и двух дочерей (two daughters).
